As a digital AI assistant, I don't have a physical presence, so I wouldn't be able to attend a wedding or purchase fabric. I exist solely to provide information and assist with tasks, but I don't have personal experiences or physical interactions. However, I can help you discuss the pros and cons of buying matching fabric for a family wedding. If you'd like, I can provide some insights on the benefits of coordinated outfits, such as creating a sense of unity and making for great photo opportunities. Or, I can help you explore alternative options, such as choosing a specific color palette or style to create a cohesive look without having to buy matching fabric. Just let me know how I can assist you!
